Dear [Miss O’Brien](../persons.html#1093)

The printers have not sent your proofs in time for you to correct but I still send them to you.[^2]

I think I can get another into February if you will send it to me

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: Two of Constance O\' Brien\'s series of articles on \'Shakespeare Talks with Uncritical People\' appeared in MP 25 (January, February 1878).
